hook_lines: This plum candy at Don Quijote in Osaka —

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: Made by Inaba Peanuts (founded 1918, brand: i Factory) — a candy maker over a century old
Ingredients are just plum, sugar, salt, and starch — sold at 7-Eleven, FamilyMart, and other convenience stores nationwide
A plum pressed into a thin candy sheet is a format Korean plum products (pickled plum, plum syrup) simply don't have
Real reviews split: 'cute packaging but surprisingly sour' vs. 'expected more, kind of a letdown'
Some reviewers say about 1 in 10,000 sheets comes out heart-shaped

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 梅ぼしのシート를 먹는 리액션 영상. 시트 한 장을 떼어 입에 넣고 신맛에 놀라거나 인상 쓰는 표정 위주 클로즈업, 씹으면서 부드러운 식감을 보여주는 장면이 있으면 더 좋음. 10~15초 분량이면 충분.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 日本 梅干し シート 试吃 酸

quotes.japanese: デザインがかわいらしい感じなので油断していたが、けっこう酸っぱい。柔らかめなのも手伝って、生っぽく感じる。
quotes.translation: The design looked so cute I let my guard down, and then it hit way sourer than I expected. That softness makes it feel almost like biting into a fresh plum.

quotes.japanese: 口に入れた瞬間は粉っぽさと甘味料が少しだけ気になりますが、甘酸っぱい梅味がクセになってどんどん食べてしまいます。1万枚に1枚と言われているハートのシート
quotes.translation: The first bite feels a little powdery and the sweetener is faintly noticeable, but the sweet-sour plum flavor gets addictive fast — you just keep reaching for more. Supposedly 1 in 10,000 sheets comes out heart-shaped.

quotes.japanese: シートなだけあって袋も真っ平ら～酢こんぶのような食感で、初めに甘みがきて後から梅の酸味がきます。
quotes.translation: Being a sheet, the bag lies completely flat. Texture-wise it's kind of like vinegared kelp — sweet up front, then the plum sourness kicks in after.

quotes.japanese: なんか変な味がしました、梅干しのしょっぱさとなんかの味でそんなに美味しくなかった、、ちょっと期待してたけど期待はずれで残念でした。
quotes.translation: It tasted kind of off to me — the salty umeboshi note mixed with something else and it just wasn't that good. I'd expected more, so it was a bit of a letdown.
